bullets.title: Quiet Asia start
bullets.text: Spot gold was 3,847.00 at 03:18 SAST, down 8.50 (0.22%) from Monday's close (Kitco).

bullets.text: Monday's low of 3,832.20 has not broken yet; Monday's high was 3,902.30 (Kitco).

bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 96% odds of a December quarter-point hike and 4% of a half-point (Mitrade); Trading Economics cites about 92%.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.7 and US yields near 5.14%, both close to their highs (Trading Economics).
